These are the words you meet in the Studio and in these pages, in plain terms.

## What you build

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Solution** | Something a person launches to get a need handled from start to finish. Underneath, it is an agent, a team or a workflow. |
| **Agent** | One AI specialist with a role. |
| **Role** | One or two sentences that say what an agent or a team is good at. A team reads the roles of its members to decide who does what. |
| **Instructions** | The text that tells an agent what to do and how, in plain words. |
| **Team** | Several agents that work together on one request. |
| **Member** | One participant of a team: an agent, another team or a workflow. |
| **Pattern** | The way the members of a team work together. There are five: Sequential, Concurrent, Handoff, Group Chat and Manager-led. |
| **Workflow** | Steps drawn in advance, run the same way every time. |
| **Node** | One element of a workflow or of an agent, drawn on the canvas: a step, a model, a channel, a tool. |
| **Node Catalog** | The list of all the nodes you can add. |
| **Prompt** | The text of a request that is sent to an AI model. |
| **Data Table** | A table of data that agents and workflows can read and fill. |

## Where you work

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Studio** | The visual editor of Agentivity, in your browser. |
| **Workspace** | Everything one installation holds: your agents, teams, workflows, tables and settings. |
| **Assistant** | The part of the Studio that builds an agent, a team or a workflow from your description. |
| **Draft** | What the Assistant has built and you have not saved yet. |
| **Canvas** | The area of an editor where an agent, a team or a workflow is drawn. |
| **Publish** | The button that saves your changes in an editor. |

## When it runs

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Request** | What a person asks a solution to do. |
| **Run**, **execution** | One request handled from start to finish. The Studio uses both words. |
| **Finished work** | What the person receives at the end of a run. |
| **Human interaction** | A moment where a run stops and waits for the answer of a person. |
| **Channel** | The way a question reaches a person, for example the chat of the Studio. |

## Models and connections

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **AI model** | The program, run by a provider, that an agent thinks with. Agentivity does not provide one. |
| **Provider** | The company that runs the model, for example Anthropic, OpenAI or Google. |
| **API key** | A secret code that lets Agentivity use your account with a provider. |
| **Credentials** | The keys and accounts that your agents, teams and workflows connect with. They are kept in **Settings** > **Credentials**. |
| **Model connection** | The credentials of an AI model. |

## Sharing

| Word | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Template** | One file that holds a solution and everything it needs. You import a Template to get a solution, and you create one to share your work. |
| **Showcase** | A ready-made solution, offered as a Template, that shows how something is built. |
| **Synergi** | The Agentivity marketplace, where the Templates are. The Studio calls it "the marketplace". |
| **VibeApp** | An application that adapts to the person who uses it, with a team of AI specialists behind it. The person sets the goal, and the screens arrive when they are needed. Written in one word, with a capital V and a capital A. |
